purpose: Prevent accidental GitHub Actions spend before the alpha.3 integration tree is final.

safeRemoteOperation.rationale: Current push-triggered workflows are scoped to main/master or tags; the upgrade branch has no push-triggered workflow.

blockedUntilFinalAcceptance.reason: The current alpha.3 integration diff would fan out into multiple pull_request workflows.

nextRequiredRemoteInput.action: Push the exact accepted local alpha.3 commit to a non-main remote branch, without opening a PR. Then integrate the two hardening commits and re-run the consolidated local acceptance suite before any PR.
